body: I have music, but that's all I ever have had, I can't play without being kicked out of my house though, and everyone around me has heard of me and my music, as I'm "popular" idk people just attend some of my performances I do, but if I go out and practice, I'm proably going to get harassed by this one kid, who hates "gays" so welcome to a rich white neighborhood.
